name_reason: Conforms to data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=dialog). Accurately names a tick latch: holds the BIOS midnight tick word (0:046C) snapshot taken when the dialog blink-phase oscillator (0x53C13) last advanced, serving as the reference point for the tick-delta throttle. No Ghidra address residue in the name; matches the sibling latch naming data_fd2_ui_recruitment_screen_repaint_tick_latch @ 0x54127. Reflects role (latch/timestamp). No change needed.
purpose: BIOS-tick latch (timestamp) recording when the dialog blink-phase oscillator last advanced; used as the reference for a signed tick-delta throttle that gates the next oscillator advance.
logic_summary: Two repaint loops compute signed (BIOS_tick@0x46C - this_latch). When the delta crosses their step threshold (fd2_wait_input_with_dialog_repaint: > 3; fd2_text_dialog_typewriter_loop: >= 2) or has wrapped negative (< 0, day rollover), they advance the partner oscillator at 0x53C13 and re-latch this = current tick. The tick is sign-extended (CWDE on read, MOVSX on re-latch) and compared with signed jumps (JG/JGE), so the divider re-arms correctly across the midnight rollover. Zero-init (BSS) makes the first loop entry see delta = tick - 0, forcing an immediate advance + latch.
datatype: uint32 (4-byte dword; signed-extended BIOS tick word stored as 32-bit)
element_semantics: Single scalar: snapshot of the 16-bit BIOS midnight tick counter at 0:046C, sign-extended into 32 bits, taken at the instant the dialog blink-phase oscillator was last stepped.
notes: Data plate at 0x53C17 was blank (<null>); created a concise PLATE_COMMENT summarizing the latch role consistent with the src comment (src is source of truth). src/input/input.c comment block (lines 770-786) verified accurate against decompilation and disassembly of both accessors (CWDE/MOVSX sign-extend, SUB EAX,[0x53C17]/MOV [0x53C17],EAX, JG/JGE signed compare confirmed), left unchanged. Other modified shards in working tree (0002d85f.json, 00053c13.json) are concurrent refiner work; commit staged only this shard + src/input/input.c.
